Which comparable domain instance is detected in which species, and where is the annotation still pending?
CDG1 = Ser-Thr/Tyr kinase domain · CDG2 = Ig-like domain 1 · CDG3 = Ig-like domain 3 · CDG4 = Ig-like domain 2 · CDG5 = Ig-like domain 2 · CDG6 = Ig-like domain 3 · CDG7 = Ig-like domain 1
Cell text is the native amino-acid interval of the detected instance. ‘Not detected’ means no representative annotation in this run, not biological absence.
